page.overview:
Who is Lony Coleema?

Lony Coleema was a Force-sensitive female grand-engineer who was part of the Order of the Sight Voltaic. Coleema disliked being addressed by droids as "Mistress Coleema," instead asking to be called "Sister."

Coleema possessed a vast understanding of technology and engineering, she also possessed powerful technopathic abilities that allowed her to communicate with and control technology.

Lony Coleema appeared in the canon Star Wars comic "A Rebel Bounty," which was written and illustrated by Nick Brokenshire. The story was published in Star Wars Adventures Annual 2020 by IDW Publishing
